root_idea.summary: Forceful handling or management of something, extended to the deliberate devising of a stratagem or plan.
root_idea.development: The root begins from strenuous engagement with an object and broadens into contriving, managing, or employing means with deliberation; related specialized uses retain the idea of exertion or forceful action.

senses.definition: To plot against, deceive, beguile, or circumvent someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: Often describes a clandestine or harmful stratagem directed against an opponent, but the construction is not restricted to human targets.

senses.definition: To devise, contrive, or work out a plan or stratagem.
senses.usage_conditions: The plan may be harmful or beneficial and may be attributed to humans or to God; the Quranic construction can present deliberate planning without asserting deception as its primary feature.

senses.definition: A stratagem, plot, plan, or artful contrivance directed toward an end.
senses.usage_conditions: It may be blameworthy or praiseworthy and often involves cunning management of an affair or action against an opposing party; translation as plot, plan, strategy, or trick depends on context.

senses.definition: A divinely enacted stratagem in which apparent respite or benefit lulls wrongdoers before an unforeseen punishment.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a Quranic divine construction, describing a calculated taking of people unawares rather than ordinary human deceit.

senses.definition: Made the object of a plot or stratagem; plotted against.
senses.usage_conditions: Passive participle denoting those subjected to the action of كادَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Deceit, guile, or circumvention; a clandestine intention to do another person harm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used for an evasion, shift, wile, artifice, or contrivance; this derived noun is kept distinct from the Quranic headword كَيْدٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deceive, beguile, circumvent, or plot against one another reciprocally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI, describing reciprocal action between two parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To use a stratagem against someone or circumvent him.
War or warfare, especially warfare characterized by stratagems; by extension, war marked by perfidy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or transferred use of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To work at, labor over, strive with, or apply oneself vigorously to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Classical Arabic branch centered on strenuous effort rather than plotting.
Said specifically of a raven or crow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give up the spirit or endure distress in giving up the ghost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Tropical usage describing the act of dying.
A specialized Classical Arabic verbal use.
Nominal use distinct from the verbal meaning ‘to vomit’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To emit fire slowly and with effort.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a tinder stick or similar fire-producing object.
A specialized use with a female subject.
Occurs in the idiomatic negated expression وَلَا كَيْدًا وَلَا هَمًّا, ‘nor intending or purposing’.
